stops.title: Church Pulse
stops.caption: The four numbers that matter.
stops.speech: Church Pulse is the top of the dashboard: branches, total congregation, confirmed members and fellowships, all at a glance.

stops.title: Needs You
stops.caption: The things waiting on you.
stops.speech: Needs You lists what is actually waiting: approvals to make, branches without a pastor, anything stuck. Click a row to go straight to it.

stops.title: Recent activity
stops.caption: Who joined, and when.
stops.speech: Further down, recent activity shows who registered and when, so you can see the week without opening anything else.
